description: This file defines mock classes for the IMediaKeysCapabilities and IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory interfaces, used for testing media key capabilities in the Rialto project. It includes mock methods for retrieving supported key systems, checking support for specific key systems, and obtaining key system versions.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory interface, providing a mock method to get media key capabilities.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IMediaKeysCapabilities interface, providing mock methods to retrieve supported key systems, check support for a key system, and get key system version.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve a shared pointer to IMediaKeysCapabilities.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve a list of supported key system strings.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Mock method to check if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve the version of a specific key system.
